verdict.rationale: HumanLayer provides general building blocks: `humanlayer automation run` can launch a coding session from a CI job or script, GitHub issues can become tasks, and the session agent can open a draft PR. However, nothing in the evidence covers ingesting security alerts, validating them, or chaining remediation into an automatically opened PR. As documented, draft PR creation is requested from the GitHub tab or diff view, so assembling this story would require custom glue. Missing for 10: security-alert ingestion/integration, automated alert validation, an end-to-end automated remediation-to-PR flow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
